name: Frondis
tagline: Managed vertical horticulture, provisioned for the individual operator.
positioning: Frondis delivers enterprise-grade climate, nutrient, and harvest orchestration to the countertop grow unit — no agronomy degree required.

hero.h1: Industrial horticulture, provisioned in your kitchen.
hero.sub: Frondis operates your countertop grow unit end to end — dosing nutrients, tuning spectrum, and scheduling harvests — so a single household can run a compliant, high-yield micro-farm.

features.title: Autonomous Nutrient Dosing
features.description: Frondis meters pH and EC on a 90-second interval and corrects the reservoir automatically, retiring the manual test-strip ritual for good.

features.title: Spectrum Orchestration
features.description: Per-tray lighting profiles for 40+ cultivars — basil, arugula, dwarf tomato — calibrated against a growth-stage model, not a guess.

features.title: Harvest Scheduling
features.description: Every germination event books a harvest window in your calendar and reorders the matching seed pods before you run dry.

features.title: Remote Telemetry
features.description: Canopy temperature, humidity, and yield-per-tray stream to a single dashboard — auditable from anywhere, exportable on demand.

features.title: Fault Escalation
features.description: Pump stalls, sensor drift, and reservoir low-water events trigger tiered alerts with a documented remediation path.

features.title: Provisioned Supply Chain
features.description: Seed pods, nutrient concentrate, and replacement wicks ship on a subscription cadence indexed to your actual consumption.

testimonials.quote: We replaced a chaotic pantry-shelf setup with two Frondis units. Yield-per-tray is now a number I actually trust, and the reorder automation means I have not thought about seed pods in four months.
testimonials.name: Marisol Devane

testimonials.quote: The escalation logs are what sold me. When a pump stalled at 2am, Frondis flagged it, isolated the tray, and had a remediation step waiting. That is enterprise discipline at a residential footprint.
testimonials.name: Anders Kohl

testimonials.quote: I run six cultivars across a wall of trays for a supper club. Frondis's spectrum profiles took my basil from inconsistent to spec, harvest after harvest. The telemetry export goes straight into my costing sheet.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan
